connectPhp.verification: No first-class AnswerVersion class was found in the older public RNCPHP class surface used by this repository.
connectPhp.closestDocumentedPattern: Older RNCPHP exposes version-adjacent behaviour through Answer fields such as AssignedSibling, SiblingAnswers, Question, Solution, PublishOnDate, ExpiresDate, StatusWithType and Links. These must not be treated as a one-to-one AnswerVersion binding.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: No first-class AnswerVersion class is verified in the older RNCPHP source used here.
bindingDifferences.rest: AnswerVersion is a first-class REST resource.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Older RNCPHP creates/updates Answer objects and uses sibling/version-related Answer properties.
bindingDifferences.rest: No POST /answerVersions operation is exposed; versions are managed through Answer/version lifecycle behaviour and existing AnswerVersion resources.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Use Answer and its sibling/version-adjacent properties in the verified legacy surface.
Modify the relevant Answer object and save it in the verified legacy surface.
No direct AnswerVersion destroy pattern is verified.
Older Answer fields expose publishing and sibling concepts but no verified VersionDetail object.
bindingDifferences.rest: versionDetail exposes draftNote, draftTime, publishedTime, publishNote, state and unpublishedTime.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: The Answer object is the primary verified knowledge object.
bindingDifferences.rest: Each AnswerVersion references an Answer, while Answer also exposes an answerVersion reference.

bindingDifferences.connectPhp: Older RNCPHP stubs use integer timestamps on Answer.

notes: Do not invent RNCPHP\AnswerVersion in application code based on the REST resource name alone.
A future current Connect PHP reference or runtime metadata dump may allow this comparison to be tightened.
The repo intentionally preserves Answer and AnswerVersion as separate concepts because REST makes that distinction explicit.
